digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership gate and composition seams across reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and mcp_server
propositions: Direct ambient config and credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across multiple subsystems and must be eliminated or registered with exact rationale
The legacy-exception set (slice C1) must reach EMPTY with no path-glob exceptions, with every config/credential name having a single owner
All legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and per-call load_config cutover must be removed only after their focused subsystem suites pass green
Redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes must remain unchanged before and after refactoring, except for explicitly recorded and justified deltas
